answer: One mask is cheap; a thousand masks made in sequence are not. Demand an identity worn in series, not parallel: each epoch an attestation seals the prior epoch's secret into a new one, lotus petal folding over petal, and no bank of machines can forge past the waiting. A pearl like that grows only layer by layer; a hundred layers cannot appear overnight. Rate sybil resistance by the one resource a farm cannot clone: honest elapsed time.
